description:
Remove a line item from a DRAFT order (the order must keep at least one item). Same provider semantics as add_order_item: Printful/Gelato edit in place, Printify cancels + re-creates. Only works while the order is a draft. Get the order_item_id from get_order_details (each item carries an id).

[#b20b6e]

order_item_id.description: The order item id to remove (from get_order_details items[].id).

name: remove_order_item
